claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive family for ClassFeatureMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Roving is always-on with no activation trigger, no use-count resource, and no rest-reset cadence. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which requires all three of those fields. A 'passive' family is needed for features that simply modify character stats permanently (possibly conditionally).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor. You also have a Climb Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_speed variant of ClassFeatureEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The v4 atom 'modify_speed' exists in the taxonomy but is not surfaced as a ClassFeatureEffect variant. Roving needs to express: increase walking Speed by +10 ft. The current ClassFeatureEffect union only contains GrantExtraActionEffect and HealHpEffect.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_alternate_speed variant of ClassFeatureEffect (climb, swim)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Roving grants a Climb Speed and a Swim Speed each equal to the character's walking Speed. This is not a flat numeric increase but a derived assignment (value = base walking speed). No existing effect covers granting a new movement type whose value tracks another speed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You also have a Climb Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: armor-type condition guard on passive effects
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Speed bonus is conditional: 'while you aren't wearing Heavy armor'. The surface has no conditional predicate type for passive effects. This guard is a closed armor-category filter, not a runtime roll or save.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: while you aren't wearing Heavy armor
